snippet.title: [TAS] Windows Syobon Action by happy_mario & TEHH_083 in 01:49.63
snippet.description:
This is a tool-assisted speedrun. For more information, see https://tasvideos.org/2370M
TAS originally published on 2013-04-21

Syobon Action, also known as "Cat Mario", is an extremely difficult Mario-clone platformer that usually takes many tries to complete.

In this run, happy_mario (https://tasvideos.org/Users/Profile/happy_mario) and TEHH_083 (https://tasvideos.org/Users/Profile/TEHH_083) aim to complete the game as fast as possible — and even faster than before, improving the previous run of this game by two seconds.
